tool.name: Alevin-Fry Generate Permit List
tool.description: of barcodes from a RAD file
tool.command: mkdir input && ln -s '$input_rad' input/map.rad && mkdir output && alevin-fry generate-permit-list --input input --expected-ori $expectedori --output-dir output #if $barcode.barcode_selection == 'knee-distance': --knee-distance #else if $barcode.barcode_selection == 'force-cells': --force-cells $barcode.force_ncells #else if $barcode.barcode_selection == 'valid-bc': --valid-bc $barcode.bcfile #else if $barcode.barcode_selection == 'unfiltered-pl': --unfiltered-pl $barcode.plist --min-reads $barcode.min_reads #else if $barcode.barcode_selection == 'expect-cells': --expect-cells $barcode.expect_ncells #end if && mkdir -p '$output_dir.extra_files_path/permit_list' && mv output/* '$output_dir.extra_files_path/permit_list'

param.name: force_ncells
param.label: Number of barcodes to keep
param.help: This amount of the most frequent barcodes will be considered part of the permit list.

param.name: bcfile
param.label: List of true, filtered barcodes
param.help: Barcodes in this list will be considered to correspond to true and filtered cells for this sample.

param.name: plist
param.label: Unfiltered barcode permit list
param.help: List of possible barcodes for the sample, e.g. an external permit list like the 10x v2 or the 10x v3.

param.name: min_reads
param.label: min reads
param.help: Only barcodes that are present at least this often are retained and considered as present cells.

param.name: expect_ncells
param.label: Expected number of cells
param.help: Value around which a robust cutoff will be chosen.
